programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: A family attempts to build a 400-square-foot cabin situated on a small island in Northern Idaho; access to the property is limited, and rough waters make it difficult to bring materials in; it's a race to the finish as winter hits the island early.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: A family builds an ultra-modern farmhouse completely off the grid in the verdant Wisconsin countryside; when the project extends into winter, they're pushed to the breaking point as they face the impact of extreme cold on the build and themselves.

programs.title: Building Outside the Lines

programs.desc: Cappie and Alex revive a structure that's deeply personal to both Cappie and his father; moving it to a new spot, they transform it into a nostalgic orchard hideaway with rocking chairs, heirloom trees and heartwarming history built into every wall.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Liz and Jake both work in the tech industry; they are recently engaged and are looking for a lakefront property to host their wedding nuptials and move into; their home tours include a home with a cliffside outdoor entertainment area.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Byram and Kendra are not only husband and wife, they are also music producers; they are looking for an awesome lakefront property that they can live in, record music in and entertain clients in the music industry.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
